relations.argument: Partial derivation, scoped: R8.2's F2a half (Lovelock uniqueness forcing EH+Lambda field equations) follows from R8.1's empirically selected target plus class mathematics that holds for any phenomena — R8.2's own narrowed form concedes the phenomena are idle inside F2a and R8.1's content is 'cited not re-established'. The non-derivable remainder of R8.2 is exactly its pricing half (G/Lambda underived everywhere; every route to EH+Lambda pays a named import), which is what survives into the irreducible set. Not merged: recorded as an edge per protocol rule 4.

R8.2's pricing half instantiates R10.1's derive-or-price schema in the gravitational action/coupling sector. Not IDENTITY and not subsumable: R10.1's quantifier is frozen (per C5) over four decomposition/selection ontology classes that do not cover coupling-constant or action-selection pricing, and R10.1 survived AS STATED, so its scope may not be widened at the minimality pass. Edge pre-flagged by the extraction itself ('candidate DUPLICATE-OF/LIMIT_RELATION'); adjudicated here as isomorphism of form with disjoint objects.

R7.2's pricing arm (every formulation reproducing Born frequencies consumes operational probability structure as input — postulated, inherited, or axiomatized) is the probability-sector instance of R10.1's meta-form; R10.1's own basis already cites the branch-weights-inherited entry as 'the QM per-case instance of constraint C2', and the R10 cluster note directs exactly this edge type ('record the edge as STRUCTURAL_ISOMORPHISM to R10.1 rather than merging'). R7.2's D-grade tested-class core (decoherence yields suppression only, never outcomes or weights; weights inherited from initial amplitudes) is NOT carried by R10.1 and keeps R7.2 in the irreducible set.

R2.2's narrowed form is a data-level statement — its own refuter graded the structural yield 'approximately nil' and directed it be carried 'as a datum-in-F2-vocabulary rather than as an extracted structure' — and its GW/EM speed-equality content is one of R8.1's five pinned data legs, so any theory satisfying R8.1' reproduces it. The one piece R8.1' expelled (the GRB 090510 photon-dispersion bound, struck from R8.1 as a cross-sector transfer) survives only in R2.2'/the data ledger as a photon-sector LIV null. R2.2' is therefore removed from the irreducible set and banked as data.

Both are theorem-grade class-consistency conditions that constrain content without uniquely fixing it: anomaly cancellation ties matter content to gauge structure but leaves the Babu-Mohapatra dequantization leak; Lovelock fixes the field-equation form but leaves two free coefficients fitted nowhere. Distinct theorems, distinct classes, no derivation either way — analogy of role only, and both are M/D-grade with the phenomena selecting the class rather than doing the forcing.

R8.3's exit-pricing clause (every graviton route, emergent or fundamental, names which Weinberg-Witten hypothesis it relinquishes) is analogous to, but not an instance of, derive-or-price: WW forces a class-exit choice via a no-go theorem, whereas R10.1 prices inputs consumed by closure audits. Different mathematics and different failure objects; keeping them separate preserves R8.3's independent theorem content.

R8.1' constrains the classical effective response sector at gate O; R8.3' conditionally constrains quantum renderings at gate M and its scoping clause (observations force no graviton, no quantization) is precisely what blocks reading R8.1' as quantum structure. Shared data anchor (the GW record) but neither derives the other — the shared anchor is EMPIRICAL_CORRELATION at most, and the firewall (stable pattern != particle) keeps the sectors typed apart.

Quantum-consistency conservation structure (chiral gauge sector, anomaly identities) and probability-rule input-independence (unitary+decoherence class) share no class, no theorem, and no basis entry; neither refuter found an edge. Both survive narrowed on unrelated grounds.

R6.1's narrowed core is a consistency condition on joint content-structure quantizability, not an input-pricing schema; its clause (iii) prices the magnitude of a violation (cutoff bound), not a selection among admissible descriptions. No isomorphism to the derive-or-price form is established by either pass, and forcing one would be exactly the silent merge the protocol forbids.

The extraction records R10.2 (selection inputs are empirically contentful, SJ != BD, stamp D) as 'the contentfulness clause that gives R10.1 its teeth', but R10.2's refutation verdict was never delivered (pass-2 input truncated mid-R10.1; no second refutation file exists on disk). Nothing banks from Stage 4 alone, so the edge cannot be typed: if R10.2 survives, R10.1's pricing form is physically loaded; if it dies, R10.1 survives as bookkeeping only. This is the single highest-leverage unadjudicated item.

Pre-flagged by the R9 cluster note as a candidate STRUCTURAL_ISOMORPHISM (the time-asymmetric boundary/state input as the thermodynamic instance of C2's derive-or-price), and R9-2 was deliberately written in the C5-compliant pricing form that survived at R10.1 — but no R9 verdict was delivered, so the edge cannot be ratified. All survivor pairs not listed here were checked and are INDEPENDENT with nothing informative to record.

R7.2' (narrowed; stamp D, tested-class scope): within closed-unitary Hilbert-space QM with declared factorization plus decoherence machinery, the RC-04 tested-class core stands with community concurrence (Zurek RMP 75,715): decoherence yields interference suppression only — no outcomes, no branch weights — and diagonal weights are inherited from initial amplitudes, not dynamically generated; the outcomes-half is carried as near-analytic/definitional; the F_u-universal 'must add the rule as postulate or initial-data' is NOT banked (conditional on the unexecuted EC_BORN_01 hostile audit; live auxiliary-premise routes: Masanes-Galley-Mueller, contested); the pricing arm rides the STRUCTURAL_ISOMORPHISM edge to R10.1; repair item: R7 cluster citation indices are 1-based against the file's declared 0-based convention.

R8.2' (pricing half only; stamp M plus ABSENCE-grade inventory): the two leading coefficients G and Lambda enter as underived empirical inputs in every corpus- and literature-audited formulation (sometimes relocated — integration constant, moduli, induced coupling — derived nowhere), and every route on record that lands on EH+Lambda pays a named import (Lovelock's extra hypotheses; Jacobson's area entropy + Unruh temperature; the bootstrap's Lorentz+spin-2+locality/unitarity; EFT's locality+derivative expansion); the F2a Lovelock-uniqueness half is REMOVED from the irreducible set as derivable (R8.1' + class mathematics, phenomena idle); the F2b Ward-identity non-selection is carried as verified mathematics grounding the import clause; DESI evolving-dark-energy pressure (2.6-3.9 sigma, dataset-dependent, unconfirmed) carried on the Lambda edge.

R8.3' (narrowed; stamp M): corrected Weinberg-Witten joint — any Poincare-invariant QFT possessing a Lorentz-covariant conserved stress-energy tensor contains NO massless spin-2 particle coupled to that tensor, composite or elementary alike; therefore any formulation rendering the observed radiative sector as a massless spin-2 quantum must relinquish a named theorem hypothesis (quantized GR pays via diffeomorphism invariance; emergent substrata generically sit inside the forbidden configuration and must exit explicitly); scoping unchanged: the observations establish classical radiation only and force no graviton, no quantization (firewall: stable pattern != particle).

R10.1 (SURVIVES-AS-STATED; stamp M): any theory formulated in one of the four audited ontology classes (Hilbert-space QM with tensor composition; AQFT type-III_1 nets; causal-set kinematics; CDT-class layered path integrals) that closes a quantitative description referring to subsystems, regions, or a distinguished state must either derive that decomposition/selection within its own formalism or carry it as a declared, priced input; no universal impossibility asserted; per-ontology failure mechanisms distinct (C4); CPR uniqueness-given-existence stands as the recorded conditional alternative keeping the form disjunctive. CAVEAT: its teeth (R10.2 contentfulness clause) and its thermodynamic sibling (R9-2 boundary-condition input) are unadjudicated — the pass-2 verdict transmission was truncated — so the meta-requirement banks in bookkeeping form pending those verdicts.
residue_inventory: R1.1 residue (data summary, configuration-scoped): in the Sinha 2010 three-slit configuration, with slit-labelled alternatives held fixed and linear evolution assumed, frequencies are non-additive (I_2 != 0) and the Sorkin functional is bounded |kappa| <~ 1e-2 of two-path interference; NOT configuration-independent — the same standard QM yields kappa two orders of magnitude larger under near-field enhancement (Magana-Loaiza 2016) or nonlinear evolution (Namdar 2023).

R1.2 residue: (a) analytic note — both-paths state outside conv{single-path states} is definitional in any OPT given non-additive data; (b) a real re-premised M-grade theorem candidate for fresh extraction: under filter/face premises, non-zero second-order interference excludes simplicial state spaces (Ududec-Barnum-Emerson 2011; Barnum-Mueller-Ududec 2014) — would enter as DUPLICATE-OF R1.1's GPT transposition, stamp M not O.

R2.3 residue (M-grade salvage): any F3 theory must distinguish, within its cone-confined structure, a controllable/locally-accessible sub-structure bounded by no-signaling from a locally-inaccessible sub-structure not so bounded; the accessible sub-structure alone cannot reproduce CHSH statistics — an accessibility layering inside one cone structure, satisfied by every evader found.

R3-1 residue: long-lived localized excitations exhibit reproducible invariants sharp at the cited resolutions (g/2 agreement ~1e-12; p-e charge equality <~1e-21 e) — the phenomenon restated; plus: a formulation with a gauge primitive has exactly conserved gauge charges (the input restated).

R3-2 residue (carried under R10, per its own refuter): persistent localized excitations require SOME conserved structure bounding the accessible state space (a conserved one-sided-spectrum quantity with the configuration constrained-extremal) — but NOT necessarily a bounded-below Hamiltonian, a distinguished/global vacuum, or energetic minimality (SM electroweak vacuum metastable; curved-spacetime vacuum non-unique; MBL/integrable mid-spectrum protection); the pattern is constrained-variational and non-quantum (KdV solitons), and its derive-or-price form is R10's.

R4-1 residue (definability note, M): unitary evolution preserves global purity, so any quantity exhibiting interference decay is a non-injective functional of the global state; which functional (partial trace, history coarse-graining, subalgebra restriction) is not fixed by the phenomena — explicitly NOT to be counted as invariant residue for the kill-condition tally, per its own refuter.

R4-2 residue (O-grade exclusion — flagged in the overreach audit as requirement-shaped): the observed visibility loss is environmentally and internally tunable at fixed molecular mass and size, so accounts attributing the loss SOLELY to an intrinsic mass-fixed rate (collapse-only with no environmental channel) are EXCLUDED — a nonempty formal class killed at gate O; this is the R4 cluster's conceded empirical content.

R4-3/R6.3 joint residue: (i) M-grade measure-side equivalence edge at 1 DOF — area preservation <=> divergenceless flow <=> locally Hamiltonian (globally only on trivial H^1) <=> Gibbs-entropy conservation relative to that measure; (ii) the reference measure / state-count structure is a contentful kinematic input consumed, not derived — to be carried in R10's derive-or-price ledger; (iii) determinism+temporal-reversibility does NOT contain it (explicit counterexamples both passes); the Carcassi-Aidala bridge is definition-conditional, VOCABULARY_ONLY grade.

THEOREM-GRADE CLASS-CONSISTENCY CONDITIONS THAT CONSTRAIN WITHOUT UNIQUELY FIXING: anomaly cancellation (constrains content, Babu-Mohapatra leak — R6.1'), Lovelock (fixes equations, two free coefficients — R8.2'), Weinberg-Witten (forbids a configuration, forces a named exit — R8.3'), Bell's theorem (excludes relative to declared hypotheses — R2.1 residue). NOT vocabulary — four distinct community theorems; but all are M-grade and class-conditional: in every surviving case the phenomena select which class the theorem bites in, and the mathematics does the forcing.

BOUNDS-NOT-FORCINGS: everywhere adjudicated, the observational record BOUNDS alternatives rather than excluding them — anomalous-EFT cutoff lower-bounded (R6.1'), marginal setting-dependence bounded not zero (R2.1), Born form untested at in-regime points (R7.1), LIV coefficients bounded (R5-1/R8.1'), extra gravitational light content permitted and priced (R8.1'), Sorkin functional configuration-bounded (R1.1). FLAG — plausibly methodological (finite precision plus null results) rather than a structure of reality; but it is the invariant shape of the entire O-gate record and the reason almost no O-stamped forcing survived as stated.

CLASS-PRIMITIVE READ-BACK (the vocabulary trap): the dominant kill mode of both passes — at least nine of the fifteen kills (R1.2, R2.1, R3-2, R4-1, R4-2, R5-1, R5-2, R6.2, R7.1) found the claimed structure to be the formalization class's own primitive reflected back as a phenomenon-forced face. VOCABULARY FLAG — YES by construction: this is a finding about extraction methodology (the protocol's pre-registered 'formulation-relative through and through' outcome), not a structure of reality; its Stage-5 use is as a discipline on any future extraction, not as core content.

REFERENCE-STATE STRUCTURE CARRIES THE PHYSICAL ASYMMETRIES, LAWS CARRY MAGNITUDES: branch weights inherited from initial data (R7.2' core, D-grade), stability/passivity as state property with the vacuum choice contentful and non-unique (R3-2 kill, R6.2 residue, SJ != BD in R10.2's basis), relaxation direction supplied by state/boundary data never dynamics (R9-2 basis). Cross-domain (QM, QFT, statmech, cosmology) and the most physics-grade recurrence after pricing — but carried at reduced strength: support is partly PROGRAM-RESULT and its two sharpest members (R9-2, R10.2) are unadjudicated.

SUPPRESSION/COARSE-GRAINING WITHOUT SELECTION: decoherence suppresses interference but never yields outcomes or weights (R7.2' D-grade core, C3); many-to-one macro-reduction (R4-1 residue; R9-1 pending). FLAG — split: the non-injectivity half is near-definitional (R4-1's kill showed any measured number is a non-injective functional); the contentful half is the D-grade tested-class fact that no dynamical mechanism generates selection, which held under hostile attack in both passes.

EFFECTIVE/LIMIT-LEVEL PINNING WITH SUBSTRATE FREEDOM: observations pin effective-sector structure (speed-agreement datum, helicity-2 EH+Lambda response, Lorentz invariance of the limit to tested precision) while the substrate stays two-ways open (BHS Lorentz-invariant discreteness vs CDT surviving foliation; no graviton forced; anomalous UV completions permitted below cutoff). NOT vocabulary — a genuine scope invariant of the record, and the reason every surviving structural claim is explicitly effective-level.

adjudication.verdict_argument: RECORD BASIS: 26 requirements extracted; 22 adjudicated (13 in REFUTATION_01.json: 12 REFUTED + R2.2 SURVIVES-NARROWED; 9 delivered pass-2 verdicts: R6.1/R7.2/R8.1/R8.2/R8.3 SURVIVES-NARROWED, R6.2 FORMULATION-RELATIVE, R6.3/R7.1 REFUTED, R10.1 SURVIVES-AS-STATED with its argument truncated in transmission but its verdict field complete). Four verdicts were NEVER DELIVERED (R9-1, R9-2, R9-3, R10.2 — the pass-2 array was cut mid-R10.1 and no second refutation file exists on disk); per protocol rule 6 nothing banks without the adversarial pass, so these are carried as unadjudicated, neither survivors nor kills. THE KILL CONDITION DOES NOT FIRE: it requires more than half the clusters returning FORMULATION-RELATIVE with no invariant residue; the actual record shows exactly one FORMULATION-RELATIVE verdict (R6.2, itself carrying a conceded no-full-evader residue), and the REFUTED verdicts left recorded residues — so ILL_POSED is not the honest verdict. NOT C: the survivor set is non-empty and non-trivial — seven survivors reduce to a six-item irreducible set (R2.2' demoted to the data ledger as B-derived by R8.1'; R8.2' trimmed to its pricing half as partially derivable from R8.1' plus class mathematics). NOT B: no regime-incompatibility appeared anywhere in either pass — the survivors are mutually compatible across their domains; what varies by regime is only evidential grade. VERDICT A, WITH ITS STRENGTH STATED EXACTLY: a small common core exists, and it has a very specific, deflationary shape that matches two of the protocol's pre-registered legitimate outcomes simultaneously ('dominated by R10's meta-form' and 'largely COMMUNITY-known'). The core is: (1) ONE O-grade structural containment — the universally coupled helicity-2 EH+Lambda effective sector (R8.1'), the only place in 26 attempts where observation forces contained structure rather than bounding it; (2) THREE M/D-grade theorem-conditions, all class-conditional — anomaly-freedom-by-declared-mechanism (R6.1'), the G/Lambda/action-selection import inventory (R8.2' pricing half), and the corrected Weinberg-Witten exit-pricing no-go (R8.3'); (3) ONE D-grade tested-class independence result — decoherence yields suppression only, weights inherited, the probability rule an input (R7.2'); (4) THE META-REQUIREMENT — derive-or-price the decomposition/selection (R10.1, the sole SURVIVES-AS-STATED); plus (5) a cross-domain DATA-BOUND LEDGER (the residue inventory: pinned precisions, Sorkin/Bell/Crooks/LIV bounds) which is the program's data, not requirements. THREE HONESTY CAVEATS BIND THE VERDICT: (i) the core is a FLOOR, not a ceiling — the overreach audit flags at least three kill-by-default decisions (R4-2's tunability exclusion, R6.2's local-detailed-balance bridge, R5-1's bound residue) that plausibly deleted survivable narrowings, and one outright verdict incoherence (R5-3 killed on routes that would equally kill the surviving R10.1); (ii) the pricing meta-form that dominates the core is flagged as PARTIALLY VOCABULARY — its schema is excluded-middle-analytic and its physics lives in the per-sector inventory facts, with its contentfulness clause (R10.2) and its thermodynamic instance (R9-2) both unadjudicated, so the core's single most load-bearing element awaits completion of the refutation pass; (iii) the recurring-structure analysis shows the dominant cross-domain invariants are the bounds-not-forcings shape of the O-gate record and the state-carries-asymmetry pattern — the first plausibly methodological, the second physics-grade but partly PROGRAM-RESULT-supported. Stage 5 should therefore treat the answer to the charter question as: a small core exists; most of it is conditional mathematics plus input-pricing bookkeeping plus community-known data; exactly one structural containment is observation-forced; and the R9/R10.2 completion plus the flagged verdict incoherence are the two items standing between this adjudication and a closable Stage-5 deliverable.
